Let \(u=|\overrightarrow{PF_1}|\), \(v=|\overrightarrow{PF_2}|\).  
From the hyperbola, \(2a=6\), so
\[
|u-v|=6.
\]
Since \(\overrightarrow{PF_1}\perp \overrightarrow{PF_2}\), triangle \(PF_1F_2\) is right at \(P\), hence
\[
u^2+v^2=|F_1F_2|^2=(2c)^2=8^2=64.
\]
Now
\[
(u-v)^2=36 \implies u^2+v^2-2uv=36.
\]
Thus
\[
64-2uv=36 \implies uv=14.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\boxed{14}
\]
